name: exile
description: Exiles a user from the Roblox group.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to exile?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

name: groupban
description: Bans someone from the group

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you wish to ban from the group?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

name: revertranks
description: Reverts all ranking events within the time of the specified duration.

options.name: duration
options.description: How much time of ranking events would you like to revert?

options.name: filter
options.description: Do you want to filter actions to a specific Roblox user?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

name: ungroupban
description: Unbans someone from the group

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you wish to unban from the group?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

name: dmrole
description: Sends a direct message to everyone holding a role.

options.name: role
options.description: Which role should be messaged?

options.name: message
options.description: What should the message say?

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Count the recipients without sending anything.

name: eventroster
description: Shows who is attending a event, and who has not replied.

options.name: event-id
options.description: The ID of the event.

options.name: role
options.description: Compare against this role to see who has not replied.

name: events
description: Lists recent events and their IDs.

name: loaend
description: Ends a leave of absence early.

options.name: user
options.description: Whose leave? Defaults to your own. Ending someone else's needs admin.

name: loas
description: Lists everyone currently on leave.

name: quota
description: Shows how many events you have hosted this week.

options.name: user
options.description: Check someone else instead of yourself.

name: quotas
description: Shows every officer against their weekly event quota.

name: event
description: Announces an event that members can RSVP to.

options.name: type
options.description: What kind of event is this?

options.name: title
options.description: What is the event called?

options.name: game
options.description: Link to the Roblox game or private server.

options.name: details
options.description: Any extra information for attendees.

options.name: channel
options.description: Where should it be posted? Defaults to this channel.

name: eventdm
description: DMs everyone who marked themselves attending a event.

options.name: event-id
options.description: The ID shown when the event was created.

options.name: message
options.description: What should they be told?

options.name: close
options.description: Close RSVPs for this event as well?

name: loa
description: Files a leave of absence. Minimum 2 days.

options.name: duration
options.description: How long? Minimum 2 days, e.g. 2d, 5d, 2w.

options.name: reason
options.description: Why are you going on leave?

name: help
description: Gets a list of commands to try.

options.name: command-name
options.description: What command would you like to learn more about, if any?

name: info
description: Displays information about a group member, and gives you some quick actions.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to view the information of?

name: roles
description: Displays a list of roles on the group.

name: signal
description: If configured, this will store a command and make it available through our API.

options.name: signal
options.description: What signal/command would you like to run?

name: acceptjoin
description: Accepts the join request from a user.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Whose join request do you want to accept?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

name: denyjoin
description: Denies the join request from a user.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Whose join request do you want to deny?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

name: joinrequests
description: Gets a list of pending join requests.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

description: Demotes a user in the Roblox group.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to demote?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

options.description: Who do you want to fire?

options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group

name: promote
description: Promotes a user in the Roblox group.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to promote?

options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

description: Changes the rank of a user in the Roblox group.

options.description: Whose rank would you like to change?

options.name: roblox-role
options.description: What role would you like to change them to?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

name: shout
description: Posts a shout on the Roblox group.

options.name: content
options.description: What should the content of the shout be? If none, the shout will be cleared.

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

name: suspend
description: Temporarily fires a user.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to suspend?

options.name: duration
options.description: How long should they be suspended for? (Format example: 1d, 3d12h, 3 days)

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

name: unsuspend
description: Removes a suspension from a user, and ranks them back to their previous role.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to unsuspend?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

options.name: group
options.description: Which secondary group would you like to run this action in, if any?

description: Adds XP to a user.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to add XP to?

options.name: increment
options.description: How much XP would you like to add?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

name: removexp
description: Removes XP from a user.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to remove XP from?

options.name: decrement
options.description: How much XP would you like to remove?

options.name: reason
options.description: If you would like a reason to be supplied in the logs, put it here.

name: xpleaderboard
description: Displays the users with the most XP.

options.name: count
options.description: How many users to show? Defaults to 10, maximum 25.

name: xprankup
description: Ranks a user up based on their XP.

options.name: roblox-user
options.description: Who do you want to attempt to rankup? This defaults to yourself.
